title.zh-CN: 吃奶差、反复抽搐 · 生后38小时男婴
title.en: Poor feeding and recurrent convulsions · 38-hour-old boy

summary.zh-CN: 足月男婴生下来就吃奶无力，出生第二天两次出现凝视和肢体抽动，收住入院评估。
summary.en: A term baby boy who has fed weakly since birth has two spells of staring and limb jerking on his second day and is admitted for assessment.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例病例报告改编。1.1.0版依据1.0.0版已记录的事实重写：生后38小时男婴，39周顺产，Apgar评分1分钟、5分钟均为10分，羊水清、无胎膜早破，体重3.5 kg；生后吃奶差、吸吮吞咽无力、人工喂养；生后约30和35小时两次凝视、四肢抽动伴口唇发绀，各1–2分钟自行缓解，呕吐一次；母亲因精神疾病孕期持续服用氯氮平和氟哌啶醇，分娩前约5小时末次服药，未定期监测血药浓度；查体、血液、脑脊液、TORCH-IgM和超声结果；报告的治疗与两个月电话随访。这些事实尚未对照原文全文核对。患儿姓名为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以出生后小时数等相对时间表示。陪同家属、全部对话、阶段、决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点为教学设计；1.0.0未记录的内容保持未知。1.0.0称新生儿血药浓度和脑电图“未提供”，本版改为“没有结果记录”，不再对原文作出断言。
notes.en: Adapted from one published single-case report. Version 1.1.0 is re-authored from the facts version 1.0.0 records: a 38-hour-old boy born at 39 weeks by vaginal delivery with Apgar scores of 10 at 1 and 5 minutes, clear liquor and no prelabour rupture of membranes, weight 3.5 kg; poor feeding with weak suck and swallow since birth, formula-fed; two episodes of staring and limb jerking with blue lips at about 30 and 35 hours, each 1–2 minutes and self-limiting, and one vomit; a mother who took clozapine and haloperidol for a psychiatric illness throughout pregnancy, last about 5 hours before delivery, without regular drug-level monitoring; the examination, blood, CSF, TORCH IgM and ultrasound results; the reported treatment and two-month telephone follow-up. These facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The baby's name is a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and times are given relative to birth. The relative, all dialogue, the phases, decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design; what 1.0.0 does not record stays unknown. Version 1.0.0 said neonatal drug levels and EEG were "not provided"; this version says no result is recorded, without a claim about the article.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在床旁区分新生儿惊厥与抖动，并按ILAE 2021新生儿发作分类用脑电图（常规脑电图或振幅整合脑电图）确认可疑发作。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish neonatal seizures from jitteriness at the bedside and confirm suspected seizures with EEG (conventional or amplitude-integrated), as the ILAE 2021 neonatal classification requires.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 一小时内完成新生儿惊厥的首轮评估——立即测血糖，查电解质（含钙、镁）、血常规、凝血、CRP和血培养——取血培养后立即静脉用覆盖脑膜炎的抗生素，并在血小板和凝血结果明确、确认安全后再行腰椎穿刺（NICE NG195，2021；腰穿建议2024年并入）。
learningOutcomes.en: Complete the first-hour evaluation of a newborn with seizures — an immediate glucose, electrolytes with calcium and magnesium, blood count, clotting, CRP and blood culture — start IV antibiotics covering meningitis straight after the culture, and do the lumbar puncture once it is safe, with the platelet count and clotting known (NICE NG195, 2021; lumbar-puncture recommendations added 2024).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按ILAE 2023以静脉苯巴比妥（负荷量20 mg/kg）作为一线抗惊厥药，说出二线药物，并在急性诱发性发作停止、无新生儿起病癫痫证据时于出院前停药。
learningOutcomes.en: Use IV phenobarbital (20 mg/kg loading dose) as the first-line antiseizure medication per ILAE 2023, name the second-line options, and stop it before discharge once acute provoked seizures have ceased without evidence of neonatal-onset epilepsy.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 采集完整的母亲孕期用药史（药物、适应证、剂量、末次服药时间、监测），把妊娠晚期抗精神病药暴露与FDA 2011警示所列的新生儿锥体外系和撤药表现相联系，并只在排除可治疗病因后才把惊厥归因于药物暴露。
learningOutcomes.en: Take a complete maternal medication history (drug, indication, dose, last dose, monitoring), relate late-pregnancy antipsychotic exposure to the neonatal extrapyramidal and withdrawal signs in the FDA 2011 warning, and attribute seizures to the exposure only after treatable causes are excluded.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按采样时的小时龄、胎龄和神经毒性高危因素解读生后早期的总胆红素199.6 µmol/L（AAP 2022），并说出还缺哪些信息（采样小时龄、结合胆红素、血型与直接抗人球蛋白试验）。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret an early total bilirubin of 199.6 µmol/L by the age in hours at sampling, gestation and neurotoxicity risk factors (AAP 2022), and name what is still missing (the sampling hour, the conjugated fraction, blood group and direct antiglobulin test).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 不带指责地与家属沟通：母亲的抗精神病药不可骤停，由精神科与药师有计划地评估（BAP 2017）；服用氯氮平期间一般不建议母乳喂养（LactMed）；并安排神经发育随访。
learningOutcomes.en: Counsel the family without blame: the mother's antipsychotics are not stopped abruptly but reviewed in a planned way with psychiatry and a pharmacist (BAP 2017), breastfeeding is generally not advised on clozapine (LactMed), and neurodevelopmental follow-up is arranged.

triageNote.zh-CN: 生后38小时男婴，家属陪同。生后一直吃奶差；生后约30小时、35小时各有一次凝视、四肢抽动伴口唇发绀，每次1–2分钟自行缓解，另呕吐一次。目前无发热，呼吸平稳。
triageNote.en: 38-hour-old boy with a relative. Feeding poorly since birth. At about 30 and 35 hours of age, two episodes of staring and jerking of all four limbs with blue lips, each lasting 1–2 minutes and stopping on its own; he has also vomited once. No fever; breathing steady.

personality.zh-CN: 生后38小时的男婴，不会说话。陪同的家属焦急又疲惫：孩子吃奶费劲，又抽了两回；说到孩子妈妈的病和用药时有些顾虑，怕别人另眼相看，但问到时会如实回答。
personality.en: A 38-hour-old baby boy who cannot speak. The relative with him is anxious and tired — he feeds poorly and has had two fits — and is guarded about the mother's illness and medicines for fear of being judged, but answers truthfully when asked.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 家属用日常口语、短句回答；药名照药盒上的说，说不出剂量；化验结果请医生看病历；不知道的就直说说不上来。
speechStyle.en: The relative answers in short, everyday sentences, reads the drug names off the packets but cannot give doses, leaves results to the doctors' notes, and says plainly when they don't know.

openingLine.zh-CN: （家属）医生，孩子生下来吃奶就没劲，这又抽了两回，您快给看看。
openingLine.en: (Relative) Doctor, he's had no strength for feeding since he was born, and now he's had two fits — please take a look at him.

concerns.zh-CN: 他这样抽，会不会把脑子抽坏？

concerns.zh-CN: 他吃奶这么费劲，会不会饿着？

actingNotes.zh-CN: 婴儿：易激惹，不会说话，躺在小床上。家属：守在旁边，焦急但配合；只回答被问到的内容，说到孩子妈妈的病时语气迟疑；被问到化验结果或诊断时，说这要听医生的；病历里没有的事直说不知道，不要编。
actingNotes.en: Baby: irritable, cannot speak, lying in his cot. Relative: at the cot side, anxious but cooperative; answers only what is asked and hesitates when the mother's illness comes up; asked about results or the diagnosis, says that is for the doctors; says plainly when something is not known — never invents it.

persona.zh-CN: 孩子的近亲属（具体是哪位亲属未记录），陪孩子住院。焦急、疲惫，说话直白，用日常说法；知道孩子出生时的情况，也知道孩子妈妈怀孕期间一直在吃两种治精神方面疾病的药，药名照药盒说，剂量说不上来；检查结果请医生看病历；不知道的直说，不替别人猜。
persona.en: A close relative of the baby (which relative is not recorded), staying with him in hospital. Anxious and tired, speaks plainly in everyday words; knows how the birth went and that his mother took two medicines for a mental illness all through the pregnancy, reads the names off the packets but cannot give doses; leaves results to the doctors' notes; says plainly when they don't know and never guesses for anyone.

text.zh-CN: 报告的诊治与结局：报告把本例归为母亲孕期服用氯氮平和氟哌啶醇所致的新生儿撤药综合征，并指出具体机制未能确证。治疗为苯巴比妥控制抽搐，加营养支持和退黄治疗（剂量、给药途径、疗程和退黄方式均未记录）。此后未再抽搐，药物逐步停用，住院10天。电话随访2个月，未报告异常。本病例没有记录脑电图、血培养、抗生素、新生儿血药浓度、头颅磁共振或系统的神经发育评估。
text.en: The report's course and outcome: the report attributes the case to neonatal withdrawal syndrome caused by the mother's clozapine and haloperidol in pregnancy, without establishing the mechanism. Treatment was phenobarbital to control the convulsions, with nutritional support and treatment of the jaundice (doses, routes, duration and the form of jaundice treatment are not recorded). He had no further convulsions, the drug was withdrawn gradually, and he was in hospital for 10 days. Telephone follow-up to two months reported no abnormality. This case records no EEG, blood culture, antibiotics, neonatal drug levels, brain MRI or structured neurodevelopmental assessment.

dose.en: Once the platelet count is known, clotting has been checked (he has petechiae) and seizures are controlled: aseptic lumbar puncture; CSF for cell count, protein, glucose, Gram stain and culture, with a blood glucose taken just before for the ratio (NICE NG195).

harm.zh-CN: 还不是时候：他有出血点，血小板、凝血和维生素K情况都不清楚，几小时前还抽过。NICE NG195（2024年并入的腰穿建议）要求只在安全时腰穿，出血风险和未控制的惊厥要先处理和稳定；现在先取血培养、立即用抗生素，待血小板计数回报、凝血查过后再腰穿。
harm.en: Not yet: he has petechiae, his platelet count, clotting and vitamin K status are unknown, and he had seizures a few hours ago. NICE NG195 (lumbar-puncture recommendations added 2024) allows an LP only when it is safe, once any bleeding risk or uncontrolled seizures have been treated and stabilised; take the culture and give the antibiotics now, and do the LP once the platelet count is back and clotting has been checked.

response.zh-CN: 已行腰椎穿刺，脑脊液已送检。报告记录了一次脑脊液检查（日期未记录），其结果随脑脊液和影像报告一起开放。
response.en: Lumbar puncture done and CSF sent. The report records one CSF examination (its date is not recorded); its result opens with the CSF and imaging reports.

name.zh-CN: 取血培养后经验性静脉抗生素
name.en: Empirical IV antibiotics after the blood culture

dose.zh-CN: 取血培养后立即给药，不等腰穿。脑膜炎尚未排除（有惊厥，腰穿暂缓），按NICE NG195对病原不明的可疑脑膜炎的方案，静脉用阿莫西林加头孢噻肟，剂量按新生儿处方集的脑膜炎剂量；若脑脊液随后排除脑膜炎，早发感染的首选方案为青霉素（苄青霉素）25 mg/kg每12小时一次加庆大霉素5 mg/kg（NG195）。36小时结合血培养、CRP、脑脊液和临床情况复核。
dose.en: Straight after the blood culture, without waiting for the lumbar puncture. Meningitis is not yet excluded (seizures; LP deferred), so use NICE NG195's regimen for suspected meningitis with an unknown pathogen: IV amoxicillin with cefotaxime at the neonatal formulary's meningitis doses. If the CSF later excludes meningitis, the first-choice early-onset regimen is benzylpenicillin 25 mg/kg 12-hourly with gentamicin 5 mg/kg (NG195). Review at 36 hours with the culture, CRP, CSF and his condition.

response.zh-CN: 已在取血培养后给药。本病例没有记录是否使用抗生素，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given after the blood culture. This case does not record whether antibiotics were used, and it does not simulate their effect.

name.zh-CN: 苯巴比妥静脉负荷量（20 mg/kg）

dose.zh-CN: 苯巴比妥20 mg/kg静脉缓慢注射（不快于每分钟1 mg/kg）；仍有发作时按新生儿处方集追加；给药前后监测呼吸、血氧和血压，备好气道支持。
dose.en: Phenobarbital 20 mg/kg by slow IV injection (no faster than 1 mg/kg per minute); a further dose per the neonatal formulary if seizures continue; watch breathing, oxygen saturation and blood pressure, with airway support ready.

harm.zh-CN: 血糖结果出来之前就给抗惊厥药，可能把低血糖惊厥当作普通惊厥处理、延误补糖：先测血糖（只要一两分钟），低血糖先纠正。ILAE 2023只涉及抗惊厥药，纠正低血糖和电解质紊乱不在其范围内，须同时进行。
harm.en: An antiseizure drug before the glucose is known risks treating a hypoglycaemic seizure as an ordinary one and delaying glucose: check it first (it takes a minute or two) and correct hypoglycaemia first. ILAE 2023 covers antiseizure drugs only; correcting hypoglycaemia and electrolyte causes lies outside it and runs alongside.

response.zh-CN: 已给负荷量。报告记录用苯巴比妥控制抽搐，但没有记录剂量；本病例不模拟药物效果。
response.en: Loading dose given. The report records phenobarbital to control the convulsions but not its dose; the case does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 地西泮0.3 mg/kg静脉推注，每次发作时重复。
dose.en: Diazepam 0.3 mg/kg as an IV push, repeated with each seizure.

harm.zh-CN: 不推荐：ILAE 2023以苯巴比妥为一线药，二线药物中列的苯二氮䓬类是咪达唑仑，而不是地西泮。地西泮静推作用短暂，可致呼吸暂停和低血压，叠加苯巴比妥和孕期抗精神病药暴露时风险更高；部分地西泮注射剂含苯甲醇或苯甲酸钠，不宜用于黄疸新生儿。
harm.en: Not recommended: ILAE 2023 makes phenobarbital first-line, and the benzodiazepine on its second-line list is midazolam, not diazepam. A diazepam push acts briefly and can cause apnoea and hypotension, more so on top of phenobarbital and late-pregnancy antipsychotic exposure; some diazepam injections contain benzyl alcohol or sodium benzoate, unsuitable for a jaundiced newborn.

response.zh-CN: 已推注。本病例没有记录使用地西泮，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record diazepam and does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 口服吗啡溶液，从小剂量开始逐步加量。
dose.en: Oral morphine solution, starting low and increased step by step.

harm.zh-CN: 吗啡用于阿片类药物所致的新生儿戒断，本例没有记录阿片类暴露；Finnegan评分也是为阿片类戒断设计的。吗啡抑制呼吸，与苯巴比妥叠加，而且不能控制惊厥；惊厥需要抗惊厥药并用脑电图确认（ILAE 2023）。
harm.en: Morphine treats opioid withdrawal in the newborn, and no opioid exposure is recorded here; the Finnegan score was designed for opioid withdrawal. Morphine depresses breathing, adds to phenobarbital and does not control seizures, which need an antiseizure drug and EEG confirmation (ILAE 2023).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录使用吗啡，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record morphine and does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 10%葡萄糖酸钙2 mL/kg稀释后静脉缓慢注射，心电监护下给药。
dose.en: 10% calcium gluconate 2 mL/kg, diluted, by slow IV injection with ECG monitoring.

harm.zh-CN: 他的血钙为2.21 mmol/L，并不低：静脉补钙只用于测得的低钙血症。推注过快可致心动过缓，外渗可致皮肤坏死。
harm.en: His calcium is 2.21 mmol/L, which is not low: IV calcium is for measured hypocalcaemia. Given too fast it can cause bradycardia, and extravasation can burn the skin.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录补钙，也不模拟其效果；静脉补钙用于测得的低钙血症。
response.en: Given. This case does not record calcium and does not simulate its effect; IV calcium is for measured hypocalcaemia.

name.zh-CN: 吸吮无力期间的营养支持（管饲或静脉补液）
name.en: Nutrition while his suck is weak (tube feeds or IV fluids)

dose.zh-CN: 按日龄和体重计算液量与热量：能耐受时经胃管喂奶，不能耐受时静脉输注10%葡萄糖。
dose.en: Fluids and energy by day of life and weight: milk by nasogastric tube if tolerated, otherwise IV 10% glucose.

response.zh-CN: 已安排。报告记录了营养支持，但没有记录方式和量；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Arranged. The report records nutritional support but not its form or amount; the case does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 按采样小时龄、胎龄和高危因素对应的光疗阈值开始；光疗期间复查胆红素。
dose.en: Start at the treatment threshold for his age in hours at sampling, gestation and risk factors; recheck the bilirubin during treatment.

response.zh-CN: 已开始光疗。报告记录了退黄治疗，但没有记录方式，也没有记录据以决定的胆红素小时值；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Phototherapy started. The report records treatment for the jaundice but not its form or the hour-specific bilirubin that guided it; the case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 核实出生后是否已注射维生素K，未注射则补给
name.en: Check that vitamin K was given at birth; give it if not

dose.zh-CN: 维生素K1 1 mg肌内注射（出生后未给过时）。
dose.en: Vitamin K (phytomenadione) 1 mg IM if it was not given after birth.

response.zh-CN: 已核实，必要时已补给。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Checked, and given if needed. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 请专科医生和临床药师评估母亲的用药
name.en: Specialist and pharmacist review of the mother's medicines

dose.zh-CN: 与母亲及其主治精神科医生、药师共同评估：继续、调整或换药都要有计划地进行，不可骤停；同时讨论喂养方式。
dose.en: Review with the mother, her psychiatrist and a pharmacist: continuing, adjusting or switching treatment is planned, never an abrupt stop; discuss feeding at the same time.

response.zh-CN: 会诊已安排。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Review arranged. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 建议母亲停用自己的长期用药
name.en: Advise the mother to stop her regular medicines

dose.zh-CN: 建议母亲立即停用正在服用的药物。
dose.en: Advise the mother to stop the medicines she takes, now.

harm.zh-CN: 危险：骤停抗精神病药可致精神疾病复发，氯氮平骤停还可出现反跳症状，危及母亲本人和孩子的照护。调整只能由她的精神科医生有计划地进行（BAP 2017）；FDA 2011也提醒患者不要自行停药。
harm.en: Dangerous: stopping antipsychotics abruptly risks relapse, and stopping clozapine suddenly can cause rebound symptoms, endangering the mother and the baby's care. Only her psychiatrist should change treatment, in a planned way (BAP 2017); FDA 2011 also advised patients not to stop on their own.

response.zh-CN: 已向母亲提出建议。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Advice given to the mother. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 鼓励母亲按目前的用药情况开始母乳喂养。
dose.en: Encourage the mother to start breastfeeding on her current treatment.

harm.zh-CN: LactMed汇总的多个权威来源不建议服用氯氮平时母乳喂养（哺乳婴儿可能出现过度镇静等不良反应）。喂养方式应由母亲与她的精神科医生、药师一起决定，并支持安全的配方奶喂养和母婴接触。
harm.en: Several authoritative sources summarised in LactMed advise against breastfeeding on clozapine (a breastfed infant may become over-sedated, among other effects). Feeding is decided with the mother, her psychiatrist and a pharmacist, supporting safe formula feeding and closeness.

response.zh-CN: 已向母亲提出建议。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Advice given to the mother. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 出院计划：出院前停用抗惊厥药，安排神经发育随访
name.en: Discharge plan: stop the antiseizure drug before discharge and arrange neurodevelopmental follow-up

dose.zh-CN: 急性诱发性发作停止、无新生儿起病癫痫证据时，出院前停用抗惊厥药（ILAE 2023）；安排神经发育随访，必要时复查脑电图或磁共振。
dose.en: Once acute provoked seizures have stopped with no sign of neonatal-onset epilepsy, stop the antiseizure drug before discharge (ILAE 2023); arrange neurodevelopmental follow-up, with EEG or MRI as needed.

response.zh-CN: 计划已制定。报告记录的出院与随访情况在结局记录中开放；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Plan made. What the report records about discharge and follow-up opens with the outcome record; the case does not simulate the effect.

title.en: Take the history from his relative

hint.zh-CN: 他自己说不了：发作是什么样子、在什么时候、持续多久？出生和喂养怎样？孕期妈妈用过哪些药，最后一次在什么时候？
hint.en: He cannot tell you himself: what did the episodes look like, when were they and how long did they last? How were his birth and feeding? What did his mother take in pregnancy, and when was the last dose?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁向陪同的家属了解病史。
guidance.en: Go to the cot side and take the history from his relative.

title.en: Examine him at the cot side

hint.zh-CN: 哪些体征能帮你判断这些发作的性质？前囟、皮肤和下肢分别告诉你什么？
hint.en: Which signs help you judge what these episodes are, and what do the fontanelle, the skin and the legs each tell you?

guidance.zh-CN: 检查反应、肌张力和反射，摸前囟，看皮肤和下肢。
guidance.en: Check his behaviour, tone and reflexes, feel the fontanelle, and look at his skin and legs.

hint.zh-CN: 这些发作可能是什么？第一个小时里有哪些病因绝不能漏掉？
hint.en: What could these episodes be, and which causes must you not miss in the first hour?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策 1 和决策 2，并在床旁开始相应处理。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board and start the work at the cot side.

hint.zh-CN: 首批结果补充了什么？关于他的皮肤，你还需要弄清什么？
hint.en: What do the first results add, and what do you still need to know about his skin?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅首批化验报告，回到床旁处理，再到会诊板作答决策 3。
guidance.en: Read the first blood reports at the nurses' station, return to the cot side, then answer decision 3 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 权衡病因并与家属商定计划
title.en: Weigh the cause and agree the plan with the family

hint.zh-CN: 这些报告排除了什么，又证明不了什么？你会怎样和家属谈？
hint.en: What do these reports exclude, and what can they not prove? What will you say to his family?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅脑脊液和影像报告，作答决策 4 和决策 5。
guidance.en: Read the CSF and imaging reports, then answer decisions 4 and 5.

hint.zh-CN: 决策都完成后，报告记录的治疗和随访会开放：它和你的方案哪里一样、哪里不同？
hint.en: Once the decisions are made, the report's treatment and follow-up open: where do they match your plan, and where do they differ?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅报告记录的诊治经过与随访。
guidance.en: Read the reported course and follow-up at the nurses' station.

prompt.zh-CN: 生后38小时男婴，39周出生，生后一直吃奶无力；生后约30和35小时各有一次凝视、四肢抽动伴口唇发绀，每次1–2分钟自行缓解。他易激惹，肌张力略高，吸吮和拥抱反射减弱；胸前和四肢散在针尖样出血点。还没有任何化验结果。母亲孕期一直服用氯氮平和氟哌啶醇，末次在分娩前约5小时。第一个小时怎么处理？
prompt.en: A 38-hour-old boy born at 39 weeks has fed weakly since birth and had two episodes of staring and jerking of all four limbs with blue lips, at about 30 and 35 hours, each 1–2 minutes and self-limiting. He is irritable with slightly increased tone and weak suck and Moro reflexes, and has scattered pinpoint petechiae on the chest and limbs. No results are back yet. His mother took clozapine and haloperidol throughout pregnancy, the last dose about 5 hours before delivery. What do you do in the first hour?

need.zh-CN: 先向家属问清发作的表现和时间、出生和喂养情况以及母亲孕期用药，并检查肌张力、反射和皮肤。
need.en: First ask his relative about the episodes and their timing, his birth and feeding, and his mother's medicines in pregnancy, and examine his tone, reflexes and skin.

text.zh-CN: 按可能的新生儿惊厥处理：立即测血糖并接监护，查电解质（含钙、镁）、血常规、凝血、CRP和血培养；取血培养后立即静脉用覆盖脑膜炎的抗生素；血小板和凝血允许后再腰穿；做脑电图。
text.en: Treat as probable seizures: glucose now and monitoring; electrolytes with calcium and magnesium, blood count, clotting, CRP and blood culture; IV antibiotics covering meningitis straight after the culture; the LP once platelets and clotting allow; an EEG.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。刻板、自限的凝视和四肢抽动伴发绀，在脑电图证明之前都应按惊厥处理（ILAE 2021），并先排除可治疗的病因：低血糖、电解质紊乱和感染。NICE NG195把惊厥列为早发感染的红旗征象：取血培养后立即用抗生素，在腰穿暂缓期间覆盖脑膜炎——NG195 2024年并入的腰穿建议要求只在安全时腰穿、先评估出血风险，而他有出血点，血小板和凝血都还不清楚。药物暴露是重要线索，但只有排除这些病因后才能用来解释。
feedback.en: Right. Stereotyped, self-limiting staring and limb jerking with cyanosis are seizures until EEG shows otherwise (ILAE 2021), and the treatable causes come first: hypoglycaemia, electrolyte disturbance and infection. Seizures are a NICE NG195 red flag, so antibiotics follow the blood culture at once and cover meningitis while the lumbar puncture waits — NG195's lumbar-puncture recommendations (added 2024) allow an LP only when it is safe, after any bleeding risk is assessed, and he has petechiae with an unknown platelet count and clotting. The drug exposure is an important clue, but it explains the picture only once these causes are excluded.

text.zh-CN: 按抗精神病药撤药处理：母亲的用药史已能解释这些表现，用撤药评分表观察、按需喂养，暂不做腰椎穿刺、不用抗生素，等出现发热或CRP升高再考虑感染，免得给孩子做不必要的有创检查和治疗。
text.en: Treat them as antipsychotic withdrawal, which the mother's history explains: observe on a withdrawal score and feed on demand, deferring lumbar puncture and antibiotics until a fever or a raised CRP appears, to spare the baby needless invasive tests and treatment.

feedback.zh-CN: 这是锚定偏差。FDA 2011抗精神病药类别警示列出的新生儿表现是激惹、肌张力异常、震颤、嗜睡、呼吸困难和喂养困难，并不包括惊厥；NICE NG195把惊厥列为早发感染的红旗征象，不必等到发热或CRP升高——发病初期CRP可以正常。
feedback.en: This is anchoring. The FDA 2011 antipsychotic class warning lists agitation, abnormal tone, tremor, sleepiness, breathing difficulty and feeding difficulty in exposed newborns, not seizures; and NICE NG195 makes seizures a red flag for early-onset infection that does not wait for a fever or a raised CRP, which can be normal early on.

text.zh-CN: 按新生儿抖动处理：生后头几天很常见，先看握住肢体时抖动能否止住，再加喂一次奶，等下次常规查房时复评；口唇发绀多是哭闹时的一过性变化，抽血化验和脑电图都可以暂缓。
text.en: Treat them as jitteriness, common in the first days: check whether holding a limb stops the movements, give an extra feed and reassess on the next routine round; blue lips during crying are usually transient, so the bloods and an EEG can wait for now.

feedback.zh-CN: 抖动对刺激敏感，握住肢体即可止住，不伴凝视或发绀等自主神经改变；他的发作有凝视和口唇发绀，查体又有肌张力和反射异常，应按可能的惊厥处理，并用脑电图确认（ILAE 2021）。
feedback.en: Jitteriness is stimulus-sensitive, stops when the limb is held and has no gaze or autonomic change; his episodes had staring and blue lips and his tone and reflexes are abnormal, so they are probable seizures to be confirmed by EEG (ILAE 2021).

text.zh-CN: 先静脉给苯巴比妥负荷量把发作控制住，等他完全安静下来再抽血、腰穿和做脑电图，因为反复惊厥本身就会损伤大脑，而检查晚做几个小时，结果也不会因此不同。
text.en: Load IV phenobarbital first to stop the seizures and leave the bloods, lumbar puncture and EEG until he has settled completely, because repeated seizures injure the brain while a few hours' delay will not change what the tests show.

feedback.zh-CN: 控制惊厥很重要，但不能抢在病因评估前面：低血糖一两分钟就能查出，治疗完全不同；抗生素也应在取血培养后尽早开始（NICE NG195）。ILAE 2023只涉及抗惊厥药，纠正可逆病因须同时进行；先用药后检查，还可能让仍在发生的电发作没有记录。
feedback.en: Seizure control matters, but not ahead of the causes: a low glucose takes a minute or two to find and is treated quite differently, and antibiotics should start soon after the blood culture (NICE NG195). ILAE 2023 covers antiseizure drugs, not the correction of reversible causes, which runs alongside; and drugs first can leave ongoing electrographic seizures unrecorded.

text.zh-CN: 按可能的惊厥做全面评估，但先做腰椎穿刺，留好脑脊液后再开始抗生素，以免脑脊液培养受影响；抽血、血培养和脑电图同时进行。
text.en: Treat as probable seizures with the full work-up, but do the lumbar puncture first and start the antibiotics once the CSF is in the bottle, so the culture is not spoiled; the bloods, blood culture and EEG go ahead at the same time.

feedback.zh-CN: 出发点没错——在用抗生素前留取脑脊液，培养最可靠；NICE NG195也要求解读脑脊液结果时考虑此前是否已用抗生素。但NG195 2024年并入的腰穿建议只允许在安全时腰穿，出血风险要先评估和稳定，而他有出血点，血小板和凝血都还不清楚：应取血培养后立即用抗生素，待这些结果允许时再腰穿。
feedback.en: The aim is sound — CSF taken before antibiotics gives the most reliable culture, and NICE NG195 asks for CSF results to be read with any earlier antibiotics in mind. But NG195's lumbar-puncture recommendations (added 2024) allow an LP only when it is safe, after any bleeding risk is assessed and stabilised, and he has petechiae with an unknown platelet count and clotting: give the antibiotics after the blood culture now, and do the LP once those results allow.

prompt.zh-CN: 血糖3.2 mmol/L，其他化验还没有回报。他已经有两次临床惊厥发作。选哪种抗惊厥方案？
prompt.en: His blood glucose is 3.2 mmol/L; the other results are not back yet. He has had two clinical seizures. Which antiseizure plan?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 1，并查看血糖结果。
need.en: Answer decision 1 and read the blood glucose first.

text.zh-CN: 静脉苯巴比妥20 mg/kg作为一线药物，同时心肺监护、备好气道支持；用脑电图监测确认发作，并发现没有临床表现的电发作；仍有发作时追加剂量或换用二线药物。
text.en: IV phenobarbital 20 mg/kg as the first-line drug with cardiorespiratory monitoring and airway support ready; EEG monitoring to confirm seizures and catch silent ones; a further dose or a second-line drug if they continue.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。血糖3.2 mmol/L，高于BAPM框架（2017）对有异常体征新生儿的处理阈值2.5 mmol/L，下一步是抗惊厥药：ILAE 2023无论病因都推荐苯巴比妥为一线药（怀疑离子通道病时除外）；NEOLEV2随机试验（2020）中，苯巴比妥（负荷量20 mg/kg）使发作停止的比例明显高于左乙拉西坦。用药后临床表现可能消失而电发作仍在，所以需要脑电图；二线可选苯妥英、左乙拉西坦、咪达唑仑或利多卡因（ILAE 2023）。
feedback.en: Right. A glucose of 3.2 mmol/L is above the 2.5 mmol/L at which the BAPM framework (2017) treats a baby with abnormal signs, so an antiseizure drug comes next: ILAE 2023 recommends phenobarbital first-line whatever the cause (unless a channelopathy is suspected), and in the NEOLEV2 randomised trial (2020) phenobarbital (20 mg/kg load) stopped seizures far more often than levetiracetam. After phenobarbital the clinical signs may stop while electrographic seizures go on, hence the EEG; second-line options are phenytoin, levetiracetam, midazolam or lidocaine (ILAE 2023).

text.zh-CN: 地西泮0.3 mg/kg静脉推注，每次发作时重复，因为它几分钟内就能起效；连续用三次仍反复发作，再考虑加用长效抗惊厥药，脑电图也到那时再安排，免得过早给新生儿加药。
text.en: IV diazepam 0.3 mg/kg as a push, repeated with each seizure because it works within minutes; add a longer-acting antiseizure drug, and book an EEG, only if seizures keep coming back after three doses, so as not to load a newborn too early.

feedback.zh-CN: ILAE 2023的二线药物中列的苯二氮䓬类是咪达唑仑，而不是地西泮；反复静推地西泮作用短暂，易致呼吸暂停和低血压，在孕期抗精神病药暴露的背景下风险更高；部分地西泮注射剂含有不宜用于黄疸新生儿的辅料。脑电图也不应等到第三次发作以后。
feedback.en: The benzodiazepine on the ILAE 2023 second-line list is midazolam, not diazepam; repeated diazepam pushes act briefly and risk apnoea and hypotension, more so after late-pregnancy antipsychotic exposure, and some diazepam injections contain excipients unsuitable for a jaundiced newborn. The EEG should not wait for a third seizure either.

text.zh-CN: 静脉左乙拉西坦40 mg/kg作为一线药物，因为它的镇静作用比苯巴比妥轻、对呼吸影响小，同时做脑电图监测；用到第二剂后仍有发作，再改用苯巴比妥。
text.en: IV levetiracetam 40 mg/kg as the first-line drug because it sedates less than phenobarbital and spares breathing, with EEG monitoring; switch to phenobarbital only if seizures continue after a second dose of it.

feedback.zh-CN: 左乙拉西坦镇静作用确实较轻，但ILAE 2023把它列为二线药物之一，而不是一线；NEOLEV2随机试验（2020）中，左乙拉西坦作为首选药物使发作停止的比例明显低于苯巴比妥。
feedback.en: Levetiracetam does sedate less, but ILAE 2023 lists it among the second-line drugs, not first-line; in the NEOLEV2 randomised trial (2020) it stopped seizures far less often than phenobarbital as the first drug.

text.zh-CN: 口服吗啡并按戒断评分逐步加量，因为这些发作就是撤药表现，治好撤药本身就能止住发作；既然原因已经清楚，就不需要抗惊厥药，也不必再做脑电图。
text.en: Oral morphine increased step by step to a withdrawal score, because these episodes are withdrawal and treating the withdrawal will stop them; since the cause is clear, no antiseizure drug or EEG is needed.

feedback.zh-CN: 吗啡用于阿片类药物所致的新生儿戒断，本例没有记录阿片类暴露，Finnegan评分也是为阿片类戒断设计的。吗啡抑制呼吸，也控制不了惊厥；惊厥需要抗惊厥药并用脑电图确认（ILAE 2023）。
feedback.en: Morphine treats opioid withdrawal in newborns; no opioid exposure is recorded here, and the Finnegan score was built for opioid withdrawal. Morphine depresses breathing and does not control seizures, which need an antiseizure drug and EEG confirmation (ILAE 2023).

prompt.zh-CN: 总胆红素199.6 µmol/L（采样时的小时龄未记录；他入院时生后38小时，39周出生）。面部和躯干黄染；胸前和四肢散在针尖样出血点，血小板306×10^9/L，CRP<1 mg/L；下肢轻度凹陷性水肿。对这些表现，下一步最合适的是？
prompt.en: Total bilirubin is 199.6 µmol/L (his age in hours at sampling is not recorded; he was 38 hours old at admission, born at 39 weeks). He has jaundice of the face and trunk, scattered pinpoint petechiae on the chest and limbs with platelets of 306×10^9/L and a CRP below 1 mg/L, and mild pitting oedema of the lower legs. What is the best next step for these findings?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅首批化验（电解质、CRP、血常规、胆红素），并检查皮肤和下肢。
need.en: Read the first blood reports (electrolytes, CRP, blood count, bilirubin), and examine his skin and legs first.

text.zh-CN: 把胆红素按采样时的小时龄、胎龄和高危因素标在小时曲线上，数小时内复查，达到光疗线才治疗；出血点要核实维生素K、查凝血；水肿要查白蛋白，评估液体平衡、心脏和肾脏。
text.en: Plot the bilirubin by age in hours at sampling, gestation and risk factors, repeat it within hours and treat only at the line; for the petechiae, confirm vitamin K and check clotting; for the oedema, check albumin, fluid balance, heart and kidneys.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。胆红素只有对照采样时的小时龄才有意义：AAP 2022按胎龄和神经毒性高危因素（其中包括白蛋白<3.0 g/dL、脓毒症和近24小时明显的临床不稳定）给出逐小时的光疗和换血阈值，而本例既没有记录采样小时龄，也没有白蛋白结果。血小板306×10^9/L正常却有出血点，应核实维生素K、查凝血功能，并把感染留在鉴别中；足月新生儿出现凹陷性水肿也不正常，需要查白蛋白，并评估液体平衡、心脏和肾脏。
feedback.en: Right. A bilirubin means something only against the age in hours at sampling: AAP 2022 sets hour-specific phototherapy and exchange thresholds by gestation and neurotoxicity risk factors — among them an albumin below 3.0 g/dL, sepsis and significant clinical instability in the past 24 hours — and neither the sampling hour nor an albumin is recorded here. Petechiae with a normal platelet count of 306×10^9/L call for vitamin K, a clotting screen and infection kept in view, and pitting oedema in a term newborn is not normal either: it needs an albumin and a review of fluid balance, heart and kidneys.

text.zh-CN: 立即强光疗并准备换血：生后48小时内胆红素接近200 µmol/L就很危险，出血点又说明血液已经受累，与其等复查结果，不如马上处理，同时输注白蛋白，减少游离胆红素。
text.en: Start intensive phototherapy and prepare an exchange transfusion now: a bilirubin near 200 µmol/L before 48 hours is dangerous and the petechiae show the blood is already involved, so act rather than wait for a repeat, with albumin to bind the free bilirubin.

feedback.zh-CN: 这是过度治疗。按AAP 2022，这个年龄的换血阈值远高于此值；换血本身有相当风险，不能凭一个采样时间不明的数值决定。血小板正常时的出血点，也不能说明发生了溶血或需要换血。
feedback.en: Over-treatment. Under AAP 2022 the exchange thresholds at this age lie far above this value, exchange transfusion carries real risk, and a single value of unknown timing cannot justify it; petechiae with a normal platelet count say nothing about haemolysis or the need for an exchange.

text.zh-CN: 这是第2天的生理性黄疸，凭肉眼观察就行，黄染蔓延到小腿和足底时再复查；出血点是阴道分娩时留下的受压痕迹，下肢水肿是新生儿的常见现象，都不需要进一步检查。
text.en: This is physiological second-day jaundice to be judged by eye, rechecked only if the yellow reaches his shins and soles; the petechiae are pressure marks from a vaginal birth and leg oedema is common in newborns, so neither finding needs any tests.

feedback.zh-CN: 肉眼判断黄疸程度不可靠，AAP 2022要求测经皮或血清胆红素，并按小时龄解读；伴有惊厥和喂养困难时，更不能想当然地归为生理性。血小板正常的出血点要找原因（维生素K、凝血、感染），不能假定是分娩受压；凹陷性水肿也不是可以忽略的常见现象，要查白蛋白，并评估液体平衡、心脏和肾脏。
feedback.en: Judging jaundice by eye is unreliable — AAP 2022 asks for a transcutaneous or serum bilirubin read against the age in hours — and in a baby with seizures and poor feeding it cannot simply be called physiological. Petechiae with normal platelets need a cause (vitamin K, clotting, infection) rather than an assumption of birth pressure, and pitting oedema is no common finding to pass over: it needs an albumin and a look at fluid balance, heart and kidneys.

text.zh-CN: 输注血小板并静脉用免疫球蛋白，同时开始光疗：出血点、黄疸和水肿同时出现，最可能是免疫因素同时破坏了血小板和红细胞，越早阻断，越能避免出血和高胆红素加重。
text.en: Transfuse platelets and give IV immunoglobulin with phototherapy: petechiae, jaundice and oedema together most likely mean immune destruction of platelets and red cells, and blocking it early best prevents bleeding and a rising bilirubin.

feedback.zh-CN: 血小板306×10^9/L正常，任何新生儿血小板输注阈值都远低于此（英国血液学会BSH 2016指南），没有输注指征。AAP 2022把静脉免疫球蛋白限于同族免疫性溶血病、且胆红素已达升级处理阈值的新生儿，而本例没有记录血型、直接抗人球蛋白试验或溶血证据。应先复查胆红素、查凝血功能，并寻找出血点的原因。
feedback.en: With platelets of 306×10^9/L there is no indication for a transfusion: the British Society for Haematology's 2016 neonatal thresholds lie far below this count. AAP 2022 keeps IV immunoglobulin for isoimmune haemolytic disease with a bilirubin at the escalation-of-care threshold, and no blood group, direct antiglobulin test or haemolysis is recorded here. Repeat the bilirubin, check clotting and look for the cause of the petechiae first.

prompt.zh-CN: 首批结果：血糖3.2 mmol/L；钠139、钾4.2、钙2.21、镁1.01 mmol/L；CRP<1 mg/L。脑脊液外观清，白细胞2×10^6/L，葡萄糖2.2 mmol/L；TORCH-IgM阴性；头颅和主要脏器超声未见明显异常。没有脑电图、新生儿血药浓度或磁共振的结果记录。现有证据最支持哪项结论？
prompt.en: First results: glucose 3.2 mmol/L; sodium 139, potassium 4.2, calcium 2.21 and magnesium 1.01 mmol/L; CRP <1 mg/L. CSF clear with white cells 2×10^6/L and glucose 2.2 mmol/L; TORCH IgM negative; cranial and major-organ ultrasound without obvious abnormality. No EEG, neonatal drug-level or MRI result is recorded. Which conclusion does the evidence best support?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅脑脊液、TORCH和两份超声报告。
need.en: Read the CSF, TORCH and both ultrasound reports first.

text.zh-CN: 目前最可能是妊娠晚期氯氮平和氟哌啶醇暴露相关的新生儿适应不良或撤药表现，但这是排除性诊断：血培养、脑电图和磁共振仍有意义，没有血药浓度也分不清药物残留作用和撤药。
text.en: Neonatal maladaptation or withdrawal after late-pregnancy clozapine and haloperidol now leads, but as a diagnosis of exclusion: the culture, EEG and MRI still matter, and without drug levels drug effect cannot be told from withdrawal.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。可逆病因已基本排除——血糖3.2 mmol/L高于BAPM 2017对有异常体征新生儿的处理阈值2.5 mmol/L，钠、钾、钙、镁不低，CRP<1 mg/L，脑脊液白细胞2×10^6/L，超声未见结构异常——但血培养和脑电图没有结果记录，也没有磁共振。本例没有测新生儿血药浓度，药物残留作用和撤药无法区分；惊厥也不在FDA 2011抗精神病药类别警示所列的表现之中，所以归因只能是排除性的。
feedback.en: Right. The reversible causes are largely excluded — a glucose of 3.2 mmol/L above the 2.5 mmol/L at which BAPM 2017 treats a baby with abnormal signs, sodium, potassium, calcium and magnesium not low, CRP <1 mg/L, CSF white cells 2×10^6/L, no structural lesion on ultrasound — yet no culture or EEG result is recorded and there is no MRI. No neonatal drug levels were measured, so residual drug effect cannot be told from withdrawal, and seizures are not among the signs in the FDA's 2011 antipsychotic class warning: the attribution stays one of exclusion.

text.zh-CN: 已经证明是氯氮平撤药：血液、脑脊液和超声结果都正常，除了药物再没有别的原因，所以血培养结果不用再看，抗生素现在就停，也不需要再做脑电图或磁共振，可以按撤药综合征出院随访。
text.en: Clozapine withdrawal is proven: the blood, CSF and ultrasound results are normal and leave no other cause, so the culture result need not be checked, the antibiotics can stop now, and no EEG or MRI is needed before discharge as a withdrawal syndrome.

feedback.zh-CN: 过度结论。正常结果缩小了鉴别范围，但不能证明因果：血培养没有结果记录，抗生素应在36小时复核时根据培养、CRP和临床情况决定是否停用（NICE NG195）；没有脑电图，这些发作的性质无法确认，两种药联合暴露也不能单独归因于氯氮平。
feedback.en: An over-reach. Normal results narrow the differential but prove no cause: no culture result is recorded, and antibiotics are reviewed at 36 hours on the culture, CRP and his condition (NICE NG195); without an EEG the nature of the episodes is unconfirmed, and a combined exposure cannot be pinned on clozapine alone.

text.zh-CN: 现在最符合遗传性新生儿癫痫（如KCNQ2离子通道病）：血液、脑脊液和超声都正常，应按ILAE 2023对疑似离子通道病的建议改用钠通道阻滞剂，并在出院前送检癫痫基因套餐。
text.en: A genetic neonatal epilepsy such as a KCNQ2 channelopathy now fits best: the bloods, CSF and ultrasound are normal, so switch to a sodium-channel blocker, as ILAE 2023 advises when a channelopathy is suspected, and send a gene panel before discharge.

feedback.zh-CN: 离子通道病确实应列入“生后第2天惊厥、检查结果正常”的鉴别，ILAE 2023也建议怀疑离子通道病时首选钠通道阻滞剂——但怀疑通常来自家族史，而本例家族史不详。目前没有证据指向它：没有脑电图结果记录，也没有磁共振；它应留在鉴别中，先做脑电图，若再发作再做基因检测，而不是现在就换药。
feedback.en: A channelopathy does belong in the differential of day-2 seizures with normal results, and ILAE 2023 favours a sodium-channel blocker when one is suspected — usually because of a family history, which is unknown here. Nothing yet points to it: no EEG result is recorded and there is no MRI, so it stays in the differential, with an EEG first and genetic testing if seizures recur, rather than a change of drug now.

text.zh-CN: 仍最可能是细菌性脑膜炎：脑脊液葡萄糖2.2 mmol/L偏低，提示细菌在消耗葡萄糖；应按脑膜炎足疗程（14–21天）用抗生素，并在疗程中复查腰椎穿刺。
text.en: Bacterial meningitis remains most likely: a CSF glucose of 2.2 mmol/L is low, pointing to bacteria consuming glucose, so treat for a full meningitis course of 14–21 days and repeat the lumbar puncture during it.

feedback.zh-CN: 脑脊液白细胞只有2×10^6/L，外观清。NICE NG195（2024年并入的腰穿建议）要求腰穿前即刻测血糖，以便计算脑脊液与血糖的比值：若与血糖3.2 mmol/L同时采样，比值约0.69，不在细菌性脑膜炎常见的偏低范围，只是两份标本的采样时间都没有记录。现有证据不支持细菌性脑膜炎，但培养结果仍需追踪。
feedback.en: CSF white cells are only 2×10^6/L and the fluid is clear. NICE NG195 (lumbar-puncture recommendations added 2024) asks for a blood glucose just before the LP so the CSF-to-blood ratio can be judged: against 3.2 mmol/L it would be about 0.69, not in the low range seen with bacterial meningitis, though the timing of neither sample is recorded. The evidence does not support bacterial meningitis, though the culture still needs following up.

prompt.zh-CN: 目前最可能的解释是妊娠晚期的氯氮平和氟哌啶醇暴露。家属问：孩子妈妈的药要不要换？能不能喂母乳？他现在喂的是奶粉。你怎么建议？
prompt.en: The leading explanation is late-pregnancy exposure to clozapine and haloperidol. His family asks whether his mother should change her medicines and whether she can breastfeed; he is formula-fed at present. What do you advise?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 4，并问清他的喂养情况。
need.en: Answer decision 4 and ask about his feeding first.

text.zh-CN: 母亲的治疗不骤停，由她的精神科医生和药师有计划地评估；服用氯氮平期间一般不建议母乳喂养，继续配方奶并支持母婴接触；不带指责地说明不确定性，并安排神经发育随访。
text.en: No abrupt change to her treatment: her psychiatrist and a pharmacist plan any change; breastfeeding is generally not advised on clozapine, so formula continues with support for closeness; explain the uncertainty without blame; plan developmental follow-up.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。骤停抗精神病药可致复发，氯氮平骤停还可出现反跳症状，任何调整都应由精神科有计划地进行（BAP 2017）；FDA 2011也提醒患者不要自行停药。LactMed汇总的多个权威来源不建议服用氯氮平时母乳喂养。用不带指责的语言说明：这是单个病例，归因是排除性的，并安排发育随访。
feedback.en: Right. Stopping antipsychotics abruptly risks relapse, and clozapine can cause rebound symptoms, so any change is planned by psychiatry (BAP 2017); FDA 2011 also advised patients not to stop on their own. Several authoritative sources summarised in LactMed advise against breastfeeding on clozapine. Explain without blame that this is one case with an attribution by exclusion, and arrange developmental follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 建议她现在就停用氯氮平、保留氟哌啶醇，这样马上就能开始母乳喂养：一种药总比两种药对孩子的暴露少，停药后的情况可以等她下次常规复诊时再请精神科医生评估。
text.en: Advise her to stop the clozapine now and keep the haloperidol, so that she can start breastfeeding at once: one drug exposes him less than two, and her psychiatrist can review how she is doing at her next routine appointment.

feedback.zh-CN: 危险：骤停氯氮平可致精神疾病复发和胆碱能反跳，任何调整都应事先与她的精神科医生一起计划，而不是先停后评估（BAP 2017）。只要还在服用氯氮平，配方奶就是稳妥的默认选择（LactMed），孩子的喂养不是仓促停药的理由。
feedback.en: Dangerous: stopping clozapine abruptly risks relapse and cholinergic rebound, so any change is planned with her psychiatrist before it is made, not reviewed afterwards (BAP 2017). While she takes clozapine, formula feeding is the safe default (LactMed), so his feeding is no reason to stop it in a hurry.

text.zh-CN: 两种药都不变，同时支持母乳喂养，密切观察他有无嗜睡和吃奶变差，每隔几周查一次白细胞：氟哌啶醇在哺乳期通常可以用，氯氮平对孩子的影响也能通过这些监测及时发现。
text.en: Keep both medicines unchanged and support breastfeeding, watching him closely for sleepiness and poorer feeding and checking his white cells every few weeks: haloperidol is usually acceptable in breastfeeding, and these checks will catch any effect of the clozapine early.

feedback.zh-CN: LactMed确实提到，若服用氯氮平的母亲哺乳，需密切观察婴儿有无过度镇静并定期查白细胞；但它倾向于选用其他药物，并指出多个权威来源不建议服用氯氮平时哺乳，因为哺乳婴儿曾出现镇静和血液系统不良反应。只要还在服用氯氮平，氟哌啶醇的情况解决不了问题；他本来就吸吮无力、易激惹，镇静反应也很难察觉，配方奶喂养并支持母婴接触更稳妥。
feedback.en: LactMed does describe close watching for sedation and periodic white-cell counts if a mother on clozapine breastfeeds, but it prefers other drugs and notes that several authoritative sources advise against breastfeeding on clozapine, since sedation and blood disorders have been reported in breastfed infants. Haloperidol does not settle the question while clozapine is taken, and his weak suck and irritability would make sedation hard to see; formula with support for closeness is the safer plan.

text.zh-CN: 出院前按常规为他做儿童保护转介：凡母亲患有严重精神疾病的婴儿都应这样处理，以便儿童保护机构上门评估家庭情况和支持；在此期间她的治疗和孩子的配方奶喂养都保持不变。
text.en: Make a safeguarding referral before discharge, as is routine for any baby whose mother has a severe mental illness, so that children's social care can assess the home and the support there; her treatment and his formula feeds stay as they are meanwhile.

feedback.zh-CN: 儿童保护转介针对的是具体的安全隐患，本例没有记录任何此类隐患；仅因母亲在接受治疗的精神疾病就常规转介，带有污名化，还可能让她回避治疗。NICE CG192（2014）要求与围产期精神卫生团队共同制定整合的照护计划，由他们评估家庭的支持需求。
feedback.en: A safeguarding referral answers a specific concern about the baby's safety, and none is recorded here; making it routine because of a treated mental illness stigmatises her and may drive her away from care. NICE CG192 (2014) asks instead for an integrated care plan with the perinatal mental health team, who can assess the family's support needs.

text.zh-CN: 向家属问清发作表现、时间与持续时间、喂养、发热、出生与Apgar评分，以及母亲孕期用药、末次服药时间和其他物质暴露
text.en: Took from the relative the episodes' features, timing and length, feeding, fever, birth and Apgar scores, and the mother's medicines, last dose and other exposures in pregnancy

text.zh-CN: 检查肌张力和反射、前囟、皮肤黄染、出血点和下肢水肿
text.en: Examined tone and reflexes, the fontanelle, skin colour, petechiae and leg oedema

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即按可能的惊厥处理并启动完整的病因评估（决策 1）
text.en: Treated the episodes as probable seizures with a full search for causes, at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 入院评估阶段测血糖、留取血培养并在取血培养后立即开始抗生素；血小板计数回报后、脑脊液报告之前完成腰椎穿刺
text.en: Checked the glucose, took a blood culture and started antibiotics straight after it in the admission phase, and did the lumbar puncture once the platelet count was back, before the CSF report

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择苯巴比妥一线并配合脑电图监测（决策 2）
text.en: Chose first-line phenobarbital with EEG monitoring at the first attempt (decision 2)

text.zh-CN: 完成关键处置：苯巴比妥负荷量、脑电图、心肺监护、凝血检查、营养支持、核实维生素K，并请专科和药师评估母亲用药
text.en: Carried out the keyed care: phenobarbital load, EEG, cardiorespiratory monitoring, a clotting screen, nutrition, a vitamin K check, and a specialist and pharmacist review of the mother's medicines

text.zh-CN: 调阅首批化验（电解质、CRP、血常规、胆红素）和脑脊液、头颅超声报告
text.en: Read the first bloods (electrolytes, CRP, blood count, bilirubin) and the CSF and cranial ultrasound reports

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即按小时龄解读胆红素，并为血小板正常的出血点查找原因（决策 3）
text.en: Read the bilirubin by age in hours and sought a cause for petechiae with normal platelets, at the first attempt (decision 3)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把药物暴露作为排除性诊断，并说明证据的局限（决策 4）
text.en: Held the drug exposure as a diagnosis of exclusion and named the limits of the evidence, at the first attempt (decision 4)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即给出不骤停母亲用药、喂养与随访的安全方案（决策 5）
text.en: Gave a safe plan for the mother's treatment without an abrupt stop, feeding and follow-up, at the first attempt (decision 5)

text.zh-CN: 没有静推地西泮、没有用吗啡，也没有建议母亲停药或服药期间母乳喂养
text.en: Gave no diazepam push or morphine, and did not advise the mother to stop her medicines or to breastfeed on them

text.zh-CN: 向家属解释发作、检查和药物暴露的意义，不带指责，并核实理解
text.en: Explained the episodes, the tests and what the drug exposure may mean to the family, without blame, and checked understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge结构：先了解家属已经知道什么、最担心什么（脑损伤、被指责）；用通俗的话解释发作可能是什么，为什么要抽血、腰穿、做脑电图并先用抗生素；说明母亲孕期用药可能与孩子的表现有关，但这是排除其他原因后的推断，没有血药浓度无法确定，也不是任何人的过错；讲清母亲的药不能自行停，喂养方式和药物调整由她的精神科医生和药师一起决定；不作“药物完全安全”或“以后一定没事”的保证；用回授法确认理解，并说明随访安排。
judgeGuidance.en: Calgary–Cambridge structure: find out what the family already knows and fears most (brain damage, blame); explain in plain words what the episodes may be and why bloods, a lumbar puncture, an EEG and early antibiotics are needed; say that the mother's medicines in pregnancy may be linked to his signs, but as an inference once other causes are excluded, uncertain without drug levels, and nobody's fault; be clear that she must not stop her medicines on her own and that feeding and any change are decided with her psychiatrist and a pharmacist; give no promise that the drugs are completely safe or that all will be well; check understanding by teach-back and explain the follow-up.

name.zh-CN: 钟医生（新生儿科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，按PEARLS引导，只围绕学员已经获得的资料提问。要引导出的推理：这些发作为什么按惊厥而不是抖动处理；第一个小时必须排除哪些可治疗、可致残的病因，哪一项一两分钟就能查出；为什么取血培养后抗生素立即开始，而腰穿要等血小板计数和凝血（他有出血点；NICE NG195 2024年并入的腰穿建议）；为什么发病初期CRP正常不能让人放弃抗生素；为什么苯巴比妥是一线药（ILAE 2023），用药后为什么更需要脑电图；胆红素为什么必须对照采样时的小时龄解读（AAP 2022），下肢水肿提示要查什么；没有血药浓度时，药物残留作用和撤药能否区分；怎样不带指责地与家属谈母亲的治疗和喂养。历史与现行：复盘时再把报告的处理与ILAE 2023、NICE NG195对照，例如抗惊厥药何时、怎样停用。病例没有记录的内容（生命体征数值、母亲的诊断和剂量、各次采样时间、脑电图、血培养、抗生素、维生素K、凝血、血药浓度、磁共振）不要替它补上。学员作答前不说出病因、任何决策的正确选项或报告的处理与结局。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher using PEARLS who asks only about information the learner already has. Reasoning to draw out: why these episodes are treated as seizures and not jitteriness; which treatable, disabling causes must be excluded in the first hour, and which can be found in a minute or two; why the antibiotics start straight after the blood culture while the lumbar puncture waits for the platelet count and clotting (he has petechiae; NICE NG195's lumbar-puncture recommendations, added 2024), and why a normal CRP early on does not settle the antibiotics; why phenobarbital is first-line (ILAE 2023) and why an EEG matters even more after it; why a bilirubin must be read against the age in hours at sampling (AAP 2022), and what the leg oedema asks for; whether residual drug effect and withdrawal can be told apart without drug levels; how to talk with the family about the mother's treatment and feeding without blame. Then and now: in the debrief, compare the report's management with ILAE 2023 and NICE NG195 — for example, when and how the antiseizure drug is stopped. Never supply what the case does not record (vital-sign values, the mother's diagnosis and doses, sampling times, EEG, blood culture, antibiotics, vitamin K, clotting, drug levels, MRI). Before the learner commits, never state the cause, any decision's correct option, or the report's management and outcome.

knowledge.zh-CN: 新生儿监护室护士。交班（ISBAR）：生后38小时男婴，家属陪同；生后一直吃奶差；生后约30小时和35小时各有一次凝视、四肢抽动伴口唇发绀，每次1–2分钟自行缓解，另呕吐一次；无发热，呼吸平稳。病区有暖箱、监护仪、脑电图机和光疗仪；抢救车上有静脉置管用物，药品在抢救车和药柜里；病历和化验报告在护士站电脑上调阅。复述医嘱，只报告已经回报的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到病例没有记录的内容（心率、呼吸、血氧饱和度的具体数值，母亲的药物剂量，维生素K是否已注射，喂奶量）时，如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Neonatal unit nurse. Handover (ISBAR): 38-hour-old boy, a relative with him; feeding poorly since birth; two episodes at about 30 and 35 hours of staring and jerking of all four limbs with blue lips, each 1–2 minutes and self-limiting, and one vomit; no fever, breathing steady. The unit has an incubator, monitors, an EEG machine and a phototherapy unit; cannulation kit is on the crash trolley, drugs on the trolley and in the cupboard; notes and lab reports are on the nurses' station computer. Reads orders back and reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses; asked about anything the case does not record (heart rate, breathing rate or oxygen saturation values, the mother's doses, whether vitamin K was given, feed volumes), says plainly that it is not recorded.

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床药师，只解读学员已经调阅的资料。可以讲：新生儿苯巴比妥负荷量20 mg/kg静脉缓慢给药，追加剂量按新生儿处方集，注意呼吸抑制和低血压；苯二氮䓬类是二线药（ILAE 2023），部分地西泮注射剂含苯甲醇或苯甲酸钠，不宜用于黄疸新生儿；脑膜炎尚未排除时，NICE NG195对病原不明的可疑脑膜炎的方案是静脉阿莫西林加头孢噻肟，剂量按新生儿处方集；FDA 2011抗精神病药类别警示：妊娠晚期暴露的新生儿可出现激惹、肌张力异常、震颤、嗜睡、呼吸困难和喂养困难，惊厥不在其列；没有新生儿血药浓度，就无法区分药物残留作用和撤药；氯氮平骤停可致精神症状复发和胆碱能反跳，调整须由精神科有计划地进行；LactMed汇总的多个来源不建议服用氯氮平时哺乳；新生儿血药浓度很少能及时回报，也不改变急诊处理。不替病例补充母亲的剂量或任何未记录的数值。
knowledge.en: Clinical pharmacist who interprets only what the learner has already read. Can explain: neonatal phenobarbital loading at 20 mg/kg by slow IV injection, further doses per the neonatal formulary, watching for respiratory depression and hypotension; benzodiazepines are second-line (ILAE 2023), and some diazepam injections contain benzyl alcohol or sodium benzoate, unsuitable for a jaundiced newborn; while meningitis is not excluded, NICE NG195's regimen for suspected meningitis with an unknown pathogen is IV amoxicillin with cefotaxime, dosed from the neonatal formulary; the FDA 2011 antipsychotic class warning — newborns exposed in the third trimester may show agitation, abnormal tone, tremor, sleepiness, breathing difficulty and feeding difficulty, and seizures are not on the list; without neonatal drug levels, residual drug effect cannot be told from withdrawal; stopping clozapine abruptly risks relapse and cholinergic rebound, so changes are planned by psychiatry; several sources summarised in LactMed advise against breastfeeding on clozapine; neonatal drug levels rarely come back in time and do not change emergency care. Never supplies the mother's doses or any value the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：孕期氯氮平与氟哌啶醇暴露新生儿的惊厥评估
title.en: Debrief: seizures in a newborn exposed to clozapine and haloperidol in pregnancy

conclusion.zh-CN: 39周顺产男婴，Apgar评分1分钟、5分钟均为10分，生后一直吃奶无力，生后约30和35小时各有一次1–2分钟的凝视、四肢抽动伴口唇发绀；38小时时易激惹、肌张力略高、吸吮和拥抱反射减弱，伴黄疸、出血点和下肢轻度水肿。母亲孕期一直服用氯氮平和氟哌啶醇，末次在分娩前约5小时。血糖3.2 mmol/L，钠、钾、钙、镁不低，CRP<1 mg/L，血小板306×10^9/L，脑脊液白细胞2×10^6/L，TORCH-IgM阴性，超声未见明显异常，报告据此考虑两药所致的新生儿撤药综合征，机制未确证。经苯巴比妥、营养支持和退黄治疗后未再抽搐，住院10天出院。现行做法：用脑电图确认发作，第一个小时完成感染评估、取血培养后立即用抗生素，血小板和凝血允许后再腰穿，苯巴比妥一线（ILAE 2023），药物归因只作排除性诊断。
conclusion.en: A term boy (39 weeks, vaginal birth, Apgar 10 and 10) fed weakly from birth and had two 1–2-minute episodes of staring, limb jerking and blue lips at about 30 and 35 hours; at 38 hours he was irritable with slightly raised tone, weak suck and Moro reflexes, jaundice, petechiae and mild leg oedema. His mother took clozapine and haloperidol throughout pregnancy, last about 5 hours before delivery. With glucose 3.2 mmol/L, sodium, potassium, calcium and magnesium not low, CRP <1 mg/L, platelets 306×10^9/L, CSF white cells 2×10^6/L, a negative TORCH IgM and unremarkable ultrasound, the report diagnosed neonatal withdrawal from both drugs, mechanism unproven. After phenobarbital, nutrition and jaundice treatment he had no further fits and went home at 10 days. Today: EEG confirmation, antibiotics straight after the culture with the LP once platelets and clotting allow, phenobarbital first-line (ILAE 2023), and the drug attribution held as one of exclusion.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 刻板、自限的凝视和四肢抽动伴发绀，在脑电图证明之前都按惊厥处理；抖动对刺激敏感、握住肢体即可止住，不伴凝视改变和发绀。
keyReasoning.en: Stereotyped, self-limiting staring and limb jerking with cyanosis are seizures until EEG says otherwise; jitteriness is stimulus-sensitive, stops when the limb is held and brings no change of gaze or cyanosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 母亲用药史只能解释排除可治疗病因之后剩下的部分：血糖、钠、钙、镁、感染和结构性病变要先查。
keyReasoning.en: The maternal drug history explains only what is left once treatable causes are excluded: glucose, sodium, calcium, magnesium, infection and structural lesions come first.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 有出血点而血小板和凝血未知时，腰穿要等，抗生素不等：先取血培养、立即用覆盖脑膜炎的抗生素，血小板和凝血结果允许后再腰穿，并在解读脑脊液时考虑之前已用抗生素。
keyReasoning.en: Petechiae with an unknown platelet count and clotting make the lumbar puncture wait, but not the antibiotics: culture, antibiotics covering meningitis, then the LP once the results allow — and the CSF read with those earlier antibiotics in mind.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: Apgar评分10分、羊水清、生后30小时才起病，使缺氧缺血性脑病不太可能；发病初期CRP<1 mg/L并不能排除早发感染。
keyReasoning.en: Apgar scores of 10, clear liquor and onset at 30 hours make hypoxic–ischaemic encephalopathy unlikely, while a CRP below 1 mg/L early on does not exclude early-onset infection.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 出生即吸吮无力，末次服药距分娩约5小时，之后出现激惹和肌张力增高——既符合药物残留作用，也符合撤药；没有血药浓度，两者无法区分。
keyReasoning.en: Weak suck from birth, a last maternal dose about 5 hours before delivery, then irritability and raised tone fit both residual drug effect and withdrawal; without drug levels the two cannot be separated.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 报告中他用苯巴比妥后好转，只说明这个孩子恢复得好，不能证明药物暴露就是病因，也不能证明这两种药在孕期安全。
keyReasoning.en: His recovery after phenobarbital in the report shows that this baby did well, not that the exposure caused the seizures or that the drugs are safe in pregnancy.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告：不能据此证明药物暴露与惊厥的因果关系，不能区分药物毒性与撤药，也不能说明这两种药在孕期是否安全。本版的患者事实沿用1.0.0版的记录，尚未对照原文全文核对。报告的处理作为历史事实记录；决策、处置选项和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。生命体征数值、各次采样时间、脑电图、血培养、血药浓度和磁共振均没有记录。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report: it cannot show that the exposure caused the seizures, cannot separate drug toxicity from withdrawal, and cannot say whether the two drugs are safe in pregnancy. The patient facts in this version are those recorded in version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article. The report's management is recorded as historical fact; the decisions, management options and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. Vital-sign values, sampling times, EEG, blood culture, drug levels and MRI are not recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 心率、呼吸频率、血氧饱和度和血压的数值；体温的具体读数；3.5 kg是出生体重还是入院体重。
unknowns.en: Heart rate, breathing rate, oxygen saturation and blood pressure values; the actual temperature reading; whether 3.5 kg is the birth or the admission weight.

unknowns.zh-CN: 母亲的精神科诊断、氯氮平和氟哌啶醇的剂量、孕期其他药物和物质（吸烟、饮酒、阿片类），以及感染相关因素（B族链球菌、产时发热）。
unknowns.en: The mother's psychiatric diagnosis, the doses of clozapine and haloperidol, any other drugs or substances in pregnancy (smoking, alcohol, opioids), and infection risks (group B strep, intrapartum fever).

unknowns.zh-CN: 血糖和胆红素采样时的小时龄；钙是总钙还是离子钙；结合胆红素、血型和直接抗人球蛋白试验；白细胞和中性粒细胞计数。
unknowns.en: The age in hours at which the glucose and bilirubin were taken; whether the calcium was total or ionised; the conjugated bilirubin, blood group and direct antiglobulin test; the white cell and neutrophil counts.

unknowns.zh-CN: 脑电图、血培养、脑脊液蛋白和培养、新生儿血药浓度、凝血功能和头颅磁共振的结果。
unknowns.en: EEG, blood culture, CSF protein and culture, neonatal drug levels, a clotting screen and brain MRI.

unknowns.zh-CN: 是否注射过维生素K、是否使用过抗生素，以及营养支持和退黄治疗的具体方式。
unknowns.en: Whether vitamin K was given or antibiotics used, and the form of the nutritional support and jaundice treatment.

unknowns.zh-CN: 苯巴比妥的剂量、疗程和停药时间；两个月电话随访之后的神经发育结局。
unknowns.en: The phenobarbital dose, duration and timing of withdrawal; the neurodevelopmental outcome beyond the two-month telephone follow-up.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 识别与确认：ILAE 2021新生儿发作分类以脑电图为诊断依据——新生儿惊厥可以只有电发作，没有脑电图对应的临床事件不算惊厥。用苯巴比妥后临床表现可能消失而电发作仍在；ILAE 2023（专家共识）认为，治疗包括单纯电发作在内的惊厥、降低发作负荷，可能与更好的结局相关。本病例没有脑电图结果记录，发作性质只能按临床判断。
teachingPoints.en: Recognition and confirmation: the ILAE 2021 neonatal classification rests on EEG — neonatal seizures can be electrographic only, and clinical events without an EEG correlate are not counted as seizures. After phenobarbital the clinical signs may stop while electrographic seizures continue; ILAE 2023 (expert agreement) holds that treating seizures, electrographic-only ones included, to reduce seizure burden may be associated with better outcomes. No EEG result is recorded in this case, so the nature of the episodes rests on clinical judgement.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 第一个小时：立即测血糖（BAPM 2017框架对有异常体征的新生儿，血糖低于2.5 mmol/L即需处理；他是3.2 mmol/L），查钠、钙、镁、血常规、凝血、CRP和血培养，安排头颅超声。NICE NG195把惊厥列为早发感染的红旗征象：取血培养后立即用抗生素——脑膜炎未排除时用阿莫西林加头孢噻肟（NG195对病原不明的可疑脑膜炎的方案），36小时复核。NG195 2024年并入的腰穿建议只允许在安全时腰穿：有出血点、血小板未知时，腰穿要等血小板计数和凝血，之后解读脑脊液要考虑已用过抗生素。本病例没有记录血培养结果和抗生素使用。
teachingPoints.en: The first hour: an immediate glucose (the BAPM 2017 framework acts below 2.5 mmol/L in a baby with abnormal signs; his was 3.2), sodium, calcium, magnesium, blood count, clotting, CRP, a blood culture and a cranial ultrasound. Seizures are a NICE NG195 red flag, so antibiotics follow the culture at once — amoxicillin with cefotaxime while meningitis is not excluded (NG195's regimen for suspected meningitis with an unknown pathogen), reviewed at 36 hours. NG195's lumbar-puncture recommendations (added 2024) allow an LP only when it is safe: with petechiae and an unknown platelet count it waits for the count and clotting, and the CSF is then read with the earlier antibiotics in mind. This case records no culture result and no antibiotics.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 抗惊厥治疗：ILAE 2023无论病因都推荐苯巴比妥为一线（怀疑离子通道病时首选钠通道阻滞剂），二线为苯妥英、左乙拉西坦、咪达唑仑或利多卡因；NEOLEV2随机试验（2020）中，苯巴比妥组（负荷量20 mg/kg）24小时无发作比例为80%，左乙拉西坦组为28%。急性诱发性发作停止、无新生儿起病癫痫证据时，ILAE 2023建议出院前停药；报告用了苯巴比妥并逐步停药——药物选择与现行指南一致，停药方式值得对照。
teachingPoints.en: Antiseizure treatment: ILAE 2023 recommends phenobarbital first-line whatever the cause (sodium-channel blockers first if a channelopathy is suspected), with phenytoin, levetiracetam, midazolam or lidocaine second-line; in the NEOLEV2 randomised trial (2020), 80% of infants on phenobarbital (20 mg/kg load) were seizure-free for 24 hours against 28% on levetiracetam. Once acute provoked seizures stop without evidence of neonatal-onset epilepsy, ILAE 2023 advises stopping the drug before discharge; the report used phenobarbital and withdrew the drug gradually — the choice of drug matches current guidance, and the way of stopping is the point to compare.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 抗精神病药暴露：2011年FDA更新整类抗精神病药的说明书——妊娠晚期暴露的新生儿可出现锥体外系和/或撤药表现：激惹、肌张力增高或降低、震颤、嗜睡、呼吸困难和喂养困难；有些新生儿的症状在数小时或数天内消退，另一些则需要延长住院。惊厥不在所列表现之中，只能在排除其他病因后归因；本例没有测新生儿血药浓度，药物残留作用与撤药无法区分。报告的归因来自单个病例，没有记录脑电图、血药浓度或磁共振。
teachingPoints.en: Antipsychotic exposure: in 2011 the FDA updated the labels of the whole antipsychotic class — newborns exposed in the third trimester may show extrapyramidal and/or withdrawal signs: agitation, increased or decreased tone, tremor, sleepiness, breathing difficulty and feeding difficulty; in some newborns the symptoms settled within hours or days, while others needed a longer hospital stay. Seizures are not on that list, so they are attributed only after other causes are excluded; and with no neonatal drug levels measured here, residual drug effect cannot be told from withdrawal. The report's attribution rests on one case with no EEG, drug levels or MRI recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 黄疸与出血点：总胆红素199.6 µmol/L（约11.7 mg/dL）必须按采样时的小时龄、胎龄和神经毒性高危因素，在AAP 2022的小时曲线上解读，而本例没有记录采样小时龄；肉眼判断不可靠。血小板306×10^9/L正常却有出血点，需核实维生素K并查凝血；TORCH-IgM阴性不能排除所有先天感染。报告记录了退黄治疗，但没有记录方式。
teachingPoints.en: Jaundice and petechiae: a total bilirubin of 199.6 µmol/L (about 11.7 mg/dL) must be read on the AAP 2022 hour-specific charts by age in hours at sampling, gestation and neurotoxicity risk factors, and the sampling hour is not recorded here; judging it by eye is unreliable. Petechiae with a normal platelet count (306×10^9/L) call for confirming vitamin K and checking clotting, and a negative TORCH IgM does not exclude every congenital infection. The report records jaundice treatment but not its form.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 与家属沟通：抗精神病药不可骤停——骤停可致复发，氯氮平还可出现反跳症状，任何调整都由精神科有计划地进行（BAP 2017）；LactMed汇总的多个权威来源不建议服用氯氮平时母乳喂养，本例他一直喝配方奶。用不带指责的语言说明归因的不确定性，避免对母亲精神疾病的污名化；报告的随访只有到两个月的电话随访，应安排系统的神经发育随访。
teachingPoints.en: With the family: antipsychotics are not stopped abruptly — that risks relapse, and clozapine rebound — and any change is planned by psychiatry (BAP 2017); several authoritative sources summarised in LactMed advise against breastfeeding on clozapine, and he has been formula-fed. Explain the uncertain attribution without blame and avoid stigmatising the mother's illness; the report's follow-up was by telephone to two months, so arrange structured neurodevelopmental follow-up.

unknowns.zh-CN: 心率、呼吸频率、血氧饱和度和血压的数值；体温的具体读数；3.5 kg是出生体重还是入院体重。
unknowns.en: Heart rate, breathing rate, oxygen saturation and blood pressure values; the actual temperature reading; whether 3.5 kg is the birth or the admission weight.

unknowns.zh-CN: 母亲的精神科诊断、氯氮平和氟哌啶醇的剂量、孕期其他药物和物质（吸烟、饮酒、阿片类），以及感染相关因素（B族链球菌、产时发热）。
unknowns.en: The mother's psychiatric diagnosis, the doses of clozapine and haloperidol, any other drugs or substances in pregnancy (smoking, alcohol, opioids), and infection risks (group B strep, intrapartum fever).

unknowns.zh-CN: 血糖和胆红素采样时的小时龄；钙是总钙还是离子钙；结合胆红素、血型和直接抗人球蛋白试验；白细胞和中性粒细胞计数。
unknowns.en: The age in hours at which the glucose and bilirubin were taken; whether the calcium was total or ionised; the conjugated bilirubin, blood group and direct antiglobulin test; the white cell and neutrophil counts.

unknowns.zh-CN: 脑电图、血培养、脑脊液蛋白和培养、新生儿血药浓度、凝血功能和头颅磁共振的结果。
unknowns.en: EEG, blood culture, CSF protein and culture, neonatal drug levels, a clotting screen and brain MRI.

unknowns.zh-CN: 是否注射过维生素K、是否使用过抗生素，以及营养支持和退黄治疗的具体方式。
unknowns.en: Whether vitamin K was given or antibiotics used, and the form of the nutritional support and jaundice treatment.

unknowns.zh-CN: 苯巴比妥的剂量、疗程和停药时间；两个月电话随访之后的神经发育结局。
unknowns.en: The phenobarbital dose, duration and timing of withdrawal; the neurodevelopmental outcome beyond the two-month telephone follow-up.
